0022600009.text: The Rockets (1-0, 1st in the Southwest and 1st in the West) visit the Spurs (0-1, one game back in 4th in the Southwest and 13th in the West) in Houston's second game of the season, and Houston is coming off a win in its only game so far. Steven Adams is day-to-day with calf soreness and is a game-time decision for the Rockets, while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and is also missing Tobias Harris, who is day-to-day with a calf strain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Rockets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 145-120 loss in San Antonio on March 8, 2026.
